_comment: Checkpoint fixtures for resume/fresh locking, rebuilt 2026-08-11 from ~/.claude/token-optimizer/checkpoints/*.md (50 files). REPLACES the earlier synthetic set whose checkpoints carried clean project-named active_task fields -- that fantasy is exactly what hid the path-identity bug (analysis-notes.md): real checkpoints store project identity in the DIRECTORY segments of modified_files/recent_reads paths (clients/acme/.../acme-monitor, PROJECTS/focus-tracker, PROJECTS/token-optimizer + the token-optimizer plugin tree), while active_task is messy voice-transcript prose that does NOT name the project. The scorer must recover identity from paths, not active_task. active_task/decisions here are lightly paraphrased from the original files (PII/secrets stripped, kept distinct per checkpoint so the replay winner-mapping is deterministic); the file PATHS preserve the same directory-segment structure. Incidents are labeled by their scenario name.

continue the token optimizer checkpoint work

incidents.description: CJK (Korean) opening prompt tokenizes without crashing and scores sensibly against a Korean active_task -> match.

Cross-client false positive: a resume-phrased prompt naming a DIFFERENT client ('competitor analysis for acme corp') grazes northwind's competitor-monitor checkpoint on the shared word 'competitor' only. Unmatched high-IDF tokens (acme, corp, analysis) are negative evidence -- the resume-intent bonus is scaled by precision (with a floor), so an incidental one-word overlap cannot ride the flat cue over threshold. Guards the multi-client regime where two clients share the clients/<x>/Retainer-Deliverables/ path shape.
